rubric: Every trade gets graded the day it goes through, one letter per side, on fit and value: did it fill a hole, did it add a guy who plays every night, and did it keep the team from falling apart. In this league a hit counts, so a grinder can be worth more than a sniper and the grades know it.
empty: No trades yet. Twenty managers and not one of you has picked up the phone. Goon says that's patience. Shoresy says you're scared of each other. First deal gets graded here the next morning.
